Economy · India

RBI decision on Tata Sons' NBFC status pending CIC license

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has indicated that Tata Sons will continue to be classified as an upper-layer Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC). RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that the central bank's principle-based framework will determine this status. However, the final decision on Tata Sons' listing hinges on its application for a Core Investment Company (CIC) license.
